verdict.line: You lose the poke war before level 6 but win most forced all-ins afterward, which is exactly why the head-to-head sits at 49.4% over 231 games with the solo-kill edge on your side.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) outranges every tool you have before level 3, so he gets to poke for free while his Grog-Soaked Blade poison ticks on any auto trade you take. Your actual leverage is that his only CC answer is W (Remove Scurvy) on an 18-22s cooldown — once that's down, your Q stacks and W (Path Maker) stun land clean and he has nothing to cleanse them with. The matchup is decided by who controls that cooldown gap, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.what: Parrrley (625 range, 5s cooldown) outranges your 450-range Q and 600-range W dash entirely. Hold minion aggro, don't facetank pokes trying to force trades you can't close.

yourWindow.when: Right after Gangplank uses Remove Scurvy
yourWindow.what: His CC-clear is down for 18-22s depending on rank. Close with E (Footwork) for the shield, stack Q twice to fire the shockwave pull, then chain W's charge-up stun — none of it gets cleansed.

start.why: 52.1% win rate over 73 games — the regen-on-hit directly offsets Grog-Soaked Blade poison ticks and Parrrley chip damage better than Doran's Helm's flat MR.

boots.why: 82.1% pick rate and the go-to choice — reduces the physical component of Gangplank's autos during extended trades once you've closed the gap.

core.why: Core 50% WR build path item — the slow-on-hit lets you stick after a W stun instead of Gangplank walking it off.
Second item in the 50%-WR line; the shield-on-ability proc covers your W charge-up window against his poke.
Final piece of the measured 50% WR core — stacking resistances directly answers the magic poison from his passive and R.

runes.keystoneWhy: You're forced into a poke-heavy lane pre-6 with no ranged answer — Grasp's proc damage and max-HP scaling win the extended trades you'll eventually land once you close distance.

summoners.why: 64.2% win rate on this pairing versus 46% for Flash+Teleport — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into real kills once you land a W stun or Q pull during his Remove Scurvy cooldown.

playing.title: Don't trade before level 3
playing.detail: Parrrley's 625 range beats your entire early kit. Farm with E (Footwork) held for the shield, not as an engage tool, until W (Path Maker) is rank 2.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit every 3.5s; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls him in. Get the second stack before you spend W.

playing.title: Bait Remove Scurvy first
playing.detail: Throw a single Q or poke with E before your real all-in. If he cleanses early, your W stun and second Q stack later land completely clean.

playing.title: Use W's charge-up defensively
playing.detail: Path Maker's windup takes reduced damage — start it while he's mid-Parrrley animation to eat the poke for free before the stun lands.

playing.title: Save R for a wall combo
playing.detail: All Out knocks him through any wall in his path — fight near lane terrain or the tribush so the knockback ends his Flash option entirely.

playing.title: Play for the item spike, not level 6
playing.detail: His ultimate (Cannon Barrage) doesn't swing lane combat much. Your real power spike is Iceborn Gauntlet online around 11-13 minutes — farm safely until then.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, win rates, and pick rates are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own read on how those numbers come about.
